author: Akien
prose: cairn groundloop stop/start/restart. the ground loop needs a CLI interface for managing it. the trouble ticket ground-loop-is-older-than-the-code-it-judges is still open because nobody restarts it. there was never an intent for superclaude to respawn the loop. the need is an operator interface. there are already file semaphore flags to stop and to prevent restart (COMMAND_EXIT.flag, COMMAND_DO_NOT_RESTART.flag in the instance flags/ folder), so this should be part of that system or that should become part of this as the case may be.
